Email template — Purchase Quote

Configure the email template used when sending purchase quotes to internal recipients within your organization.

Purchase quotes can be emailed directly from the system to team members or departments who need to review or approve them.

Template Customization

Customize the Subject line to clearly identify purchase quote emails in recipients' inboxes.

Design the Message Body using plain text or HTML formatting to include relevant information about the purchase quote.

Use placeholders to automatically insert dynamic content such as quote numbers, supplier names, dates, and amounts.

Subject

Default email subject line when emailing purchase quotes.

Message body

Default email body text when emailing purchase quotes. You can include merge fields to personalize the message.
